_description: Format layer. The selected format's object is sent as planned_ads[].format. Empty fields are omitted.

HERO.label: Hero
HERO.description: A HERO ad presents the product, offer, outcome, or main proposition immediately. One dominant headline, strong visual hierarchy, product prominently displayed, short supporting copy, one primary message, CTA, optional trust line. Optimize for immediate comprehension and low copy density. Format is the presentation system, not a persuasion framework.
HERO.skeleton:
Headline
Support line
Optional proof/trust line
CTA

BA.label: Before / After
BA.description: BEFORE_AFTER is a presentation format that shows contrast between a current state and a desired state. It is not the same as the BAB copy framework. For health or appearance products, use conceptual, routine, or process contrasts. Do not fabricate physical transformations or guaranteed results.
BA.skeleton:
Headline (the contrast)
Before state
After state
Bridge / why the shift is possible
CTA

TEST.label: Testimonial
TEST.description: A TESTIMONIAL ad communicates through customer experience or verified social proof. Never fabricate customers, quotes, ratings, results, or review text. If verified testimonial material is unavailable, keep the layout but do not invent testimonial claims. Use role-based attribution, not personal names.
TEST.skeleton:
Customer statement or representative line
Experience / outcome
Product attribution
Trust line
CTA

FEAT.label: Feature
FEAT.description: FEATURE ads focus on one or more capabilities, components, or mechanisms. Do not simply list features. Translate each feature into user relevance: feature, then why it helps, then the benefit. One feature should normally dominate.
FEAT.skeleton:
Feature headline
Feature explanation / why it matters
Benefit
CTA

UGC.label: UGC
UGC.description: UGC should feel like person-to-person communication rather than polished brand advertising. Conversational, direct, experience-oriented. Do not create false authenticity or claim generated personas are genuine customers.
UGC.skeleton:
Hook
Problem or observation
Explanation
Product introduction
Reason to care
CTA
